lead.headline: East Texas A&M won at Oklahoma, and McNeese rates highest
lead.deck: Twelve schools along the Gulf South. McNeese is the only one in our national top 100.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Southland, 12 schools from Natchitoches and New Orleans across Texas to Corpus Christi and the Rio Grande Valley. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
East Texas A&M opened with a 68-64 win at Oklahoma and a 72-71 win at Rice. The Lions are 3-1, and they won 94-88 in overtime at Portland on Friday as 7-point underdogs.
McNeese rates highest in the league at 81st after a 99-78 win over UAB.
Houston Christian is 4-0 and won 87-76 at South Dakota as a 4-point underdog.
Stephen F. Austin (133rd) won its first three before losing 81-78 in overtime to Rice on Saturday.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **2.** Road wins for East Texas A&M in its first week, at Oklahoma and at Rice.
**4.** Overtime games the Southland has played already, two of them by East Texas A&M.
**0.** Wins for Incarnate Word, which is 0-4.
